newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 15.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Henri Konan Bedie assures visiting American business delegation that reforms of commercial law are under way and says London Club deal on Ivory Coast's commercial debt and other contacts were helping ease its foreign debt burden.

- Ivorian cabinet meets today Wednesday in inland capital Yamoussoukro, birthplace of founding president Felix Houphouet-Boigny, as a signal of Bedie's commitment to reinforce its role as the political capital.

- Ivorian government meets amid speculation that a reshuffle may be imminent to bring in mainstream opposition members; leader of opposition Ivorian Popular Front (FPI), Laurent Gbagbo, says no-one has contacted his party about joining a broad-based government.
- Visiting U.S. investors interested by impending privatisation of state sugar company SODESUCRE and a project for a third thermal power station
- Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan hosts international conference on electricity supply with American experts playing a leading role ($1=538 CFA francs) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
